items.text: OUT-001 covers the identified affected consumer/scope pairs with actual responsible owners, prior and renewed basis, adoption point or explicit unestablished status and supporting evidence; prepared notice or App acceptance alone establishes no Root, Runtime or Piping adoption. Verified by VER-001.

verification.text: Inspect OUT-001 against the affected-consumer inventory and DEP-006. For each claimed consumer/scope adoption, follow the named owner's decision/action evidence to its actual subject and adoption point; compare pending or partial rows with the claimed overall coverage. Confirm that App-only acceptance or prepared notices cannot supply the missing receiving evidence. Evidence: reviewed coverage/receipt references and specific absent or partial contributions. Verifies AC-001.

items.text: OUT-001 keeps publication, source resolution, actual supply, provider adoption, observed behavior and receiving adoption separately warranted, preserves truthful actor/recorder custody for an actually performed decision, and rejects fabricated adoption from publication, registration, a check or a prepared notice. Verified by VER-002.

verification.text: Examine the account with distinct supported and unsupported states: publication with no supply evidence; resolved content with no provider-adoption evidence; provider adoption with no behavior witness; and App adoption with no other consumer adoption. Also inspect a faithful record of an actually performed human adoption act, keeping its human actor distinct from the coordinator recorder and preserving any reported-custody limits. Reject fabricated decisions and any inference that independent checking requires an unrelated acceptance first. Clearly identify illustrative cases as such; no fabricated case is a real adoption witness. Evidence: source-bound distinction/custody review and case outcomes. Verifies AC-002.

items.text: Newly supplied instructions in OUT-001 have retrievable source-qualified origins, actual edition/revision/content identities and scoped adoption points; historical supplied basis remains preserved, and selected run editions are not silently represented as broader adoption. Verified by VER-003.

verification.text: Trace newly supplied instruction examples from the source-qualified origin, edition/revision and exact content identity through selected/resolved and actual supply evidence to the receiving adoption point. Revisit a prior basis or revised same-named source and confirm the historical identity survives; compare a run-only selection with any separately evidenced broader adoption. Evidence: identity/supply/history trace with missing evidence identified. Verifies AC-003.

items.text: OUT-002 accounts for affected consumers, packaging, tool paths and implementation dependencies and carries a source-bound comparison of relevant later mainline/consumer changes before current implementation-map reliance, with unchecked or unsupported claims remaining explicit. Verified by VER-004.

verification.text: Follow affected active-source references to actual consumers and their packaging/tool paths/dependencies. Compare the relied-on pinned account with relevant identified later mainline and consumer sources, inspect the affected owners' applicable checks and distinguish source/test definitions from performed checks or deployed behavior. Report comparison coverage and any currency gap before the related reliance. Evidence: current-source applicability comparison and referenced check results, including unaffected or unresolved consequences where warranted. Verifies AC-004.

items.text: OUT-003 preserves each affected technical promise's responsible SoW/derivative path, receiving owner, actual returned change and relevant verification evidence or specific gap, without converting a notice, acceptance or source inspection into an applied or verified change. Verified by VER-005.

verification.text: Follow each affected technical promise from its source and responsibility allocation to the responsible SoW/derivative, received change and relevant candidate-bound verification evidence. Check that no relocated promise is silently dropped and no owner is replaced by the App coordinator; distinguish received proposals, owner dispositions, applied changes and actual checks. Evidence: reviewed promise/change/check trace and remaining obligations with owner and point of need. Verifies AC-005.

items.text: The adoption outputs retain the named unresolved owners and points of need, actual consumer responsibility boundaries and continuity/replacement interfaces without selecting a new precedence tree, mandatory thin-loop form, shared implementation allocation or retirement outcome. Verified by VER-006.

verification.text: Review the account against CLM-002 through CLM-004, REQ-007 and TBD-001 through TBD-006. Check each excluded act against its cited owner, carry consequential departures to the actual owner, and verify that pending distribution/placement/transition choices remain pending rather than becoming invented architecture. Confirm that continuity/replacement consumers receive truthful status and that independent definition remains possible. Evidence: boundary and open-matter review with any conflict's exact source loci. Verifies AC-006.
